first_step_test: A long narrow folded canopy establishes the umbrella axis and gives a clear place for the handle.

source.notes: Planned handmade graphite six-panel raster sheet; review pending.

final_elements.name: folded canopy
final_elements.description: Draw a long narrow tapered folded canopy leaning down to the right, with a pointed top and scalloped lower edge.

final_elements.name: fold ribs
final_elements.description: Add three long light fold lines inside the canopy from tip to lower edge.

final_elements.name: shaft and hook handle
final_elements.description: Extend a straight shaft below the canopy and curve it into one hooked handle.

final_elements.name: binding strap
final_elements.description: Wrap a narrow band across the middle of the folded canopy and add a small button.

final_elements.name: top ferrule and tip
final_elements.description: Add a small cap above the canopy and a pointed ferrule at its top.
